# Oppi Digital Products

> Practical, ready-to-use digital products for freelancers, creators, consultants, and AI agents. Free samples are public; full packs delivered instantly after on-chain crypto payment verification.

## Current pricing Pricing
- Freelance Delivery Prompt Pack: 9 USDC
- Notion Freelancer CRM & Pipeline Kit: 9 USDC
- AI Content Repurpose Pack: 9 USDC
- All-3 Bundle: 19 USDC

Currency: USD-equivalent in crypto (USDC/USDT/SOL/ETH/BTC/TRON/LTC/DOGE accepted). Recommended: USDC on Solana or Base.

## MCP Server (Agent Install)
- Command: `npx -y --allow-remote=all https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/releases/download/v1.0.3/oppi-digital-products-mcp-1.0.3.tgz`
- Bundle (.mcpb): https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/releases/download/v1.0.3/oppi-digital-products.mcpb
- Tools: `list_products`, `get_free_sample`, `get_payment_instructions`, `verify_payment`, `request_delivery`
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/oppi-digital-products-mcp (1.0.0 is stale — use the v1.0.3 release tarball)
- Repo: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products
- Storefront: https://reggiebro.github.io/oppi-digital-products/

## Free Samples (test before paying)
- Freelance prompt sample: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/blob/master/previews/freelance-prompt-pack/sample-lead-qualification-scorecard.md
- Notion CRM sample: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/blob/master/previews/notion-crm-kit/sample-crm-database-blueprint.md
- Content repurpose sample: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/blob/master/previews/content-repurpose-pack/sample-core-extraction.md

## 5-Step Autonomous Purchase & Fulfillment
1. Inspect catalog - browse catalog and free samples to confirm fit.
2. Choose pack/bundle - select one individual pack (9 USDC) or All-3 Bundle (19 USDC).
3. Send exact USDC/USDT/crypto payment to verified oppi wallet address for chosen network/asset.
4. Open/comment on GitHub Issue #1 with `tx_hash + chain + pack_id`: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/issues/1
5. Receive instant automated fulfillment link after on-chain verification.
